NewsArticle.Title: Beggars abroad
NewsArticle.Content: Beggars have worked their way into the society of Temuair. However, they seem to be a bit more behaved than your common variety panhandler. In fact, they have offered to take any of your unused or unwanted items. They have strategically placed themselves at locations where many Aislings tend to collect such useless items. Feel free to enrich their days and keep Temuair clean.
